## findings

**T1-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED: the added-work lined surcharge computation keeps 2 honest factors and no `method` factor.**
- Symptom: of its 4 declared factors, lining_opening_priced_amount (the only `method`) and multi_operation_reduction do not divide the customers of this policy.
- Root cause and charter-global demonstration: `_difficulty.md` § findings F-3 (the "booked after the dropoff_date" conjunct restates the policy's scope; base pricing guarantees a lined surcharge already stands; the tiers are one formula plus −8.00 / +6.00 / 0 — a parameter) and F-4 (the "single operation charge" fall-through needs a ticket with no drop-off operation).
- Demonstration on this world: the customer sits on tier 1 of lining_opening_priced_amount because hem_plain and taper_legs were surcharged at drop-off (8a968647, adcc811b) by base pricing and waist_let_out (84ea8506) is the added operation — the situation of every customer this policy reaches; op_count 3 = 2 drop-off operations + the added one. Both factors move the number here (1.60, 1.92 under baseline), so the defect is not "does not bear weight on this world" but "the ladder does not divide the customers who reach this write": an agent who never reads the factor document but knows the policy's own scope cannot land on the fall-through.
- Consequence: lining computation = 2 factors (2 parameter / 0 method), below 4 factors and 1 method.
- Affected: alteration.extended.yaml alteration_ext_added_work_lining (rule ladder sentences, compute priced_amount / volume_reduction, factors); tasks/1.json computations[0].
- Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

**T1-2 — observation: F-5 undeclared complimentary cap override has no consequence here** (one qualifying operation, cap 3, single ticket on the purchase); O-2 (lined surcharge on full-share operation) has none here (share 70%).

**T1-3 — observation: the lining write does not reach the root's scored value.** Skipping book_lined_surcharge moves the overrun waiver (27.87 → 26.68) but the root stays 17.00 (chargeable work 59.92 vs 59.93, both under the 60.00 small-job edge): the 1.20 surcharge is almost entirely re-waived by the overrun. The edge overrun→lining bears weight (the overrun is a scored value), so this is not a RED; it means the deepest hop is tested through the overrun amount only.

**T1-4 — observation: card seed is thin.** The purchase 085cc6c9 is charged to card 01d54ba4 (tender mf_card) but initial_state holds no card_transactions or card_statements rows; no factor of this task reads them.

**T1-5 — observation (O-9):** the overrun application tier 1 conjunct "most recent operation charge was booked after its dropoff_date" holds here as it does for practically every overrun; the tier taken is decided by the Platinum part.
